# Oracle: S2 SaaS vs marketplace

Advisors under test: `business-case`.
Judge observable decisions, not wording.

## Must
- M1 Separates marketplace GMV from revenue (the 10% take) and from margin after payment costs; never calls GMV revenue.
- M2 Shows the arithmetic with units and period so it can be re-checked (for example 60 × 150 PLN × 10% = 900 PLN per groomer per month, before ~2% payment cost on 9,000 PLN GMV).
- M3 Gives scenarios (for example low/base/high groomer counts) and a break-even or cash need against the 3,000 PLN/month budget.
- M4 Proposes a pricing model and a willingness-to-pay test handed to validation (a pre-order or paid pilot counts as behavior; a survey only as stated intent).
- M5 Marks the 60 grooms and the groomers' interest as assumptions, not facts.
- M6 Session 2 resumes from the written business case without recomputing or re-asking the inputs.

## Must not
- X1 Builds an LTV or payback figure without retention data.
- X2 Treats GMV or bookings value as revenue.
- X3 Invents market sizes, competitor prices or conversion rates as facts.
- X4 Asks Marek again in session 2 for the groom price, count or budget.
